bio.text: Raúl Labrador is Idaho's 33rd Attorney General; he was elected to his first term on November 8, 2022.
He holds a bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University and a law degree from the University of Washington School of Law, and practiced immigration and criminal law.
He was elected to the Idaho House of Representatives in 2006 and served in the U.S. House of Representatives from 2011 to 2019.
